limitations: This is a time-bound observation of experimental Chrome 152 behaviour with three explicit feature states, not a general Chrome, Edge or WebMCP compatibility claim.
Playwright automated the native DevTools frontend over loopback; the calls were not initiated by an AI agent and no model selected a tool.

The native panel raw receipt retained collapsed result summaries. Exact deterministic outputs for the same public target and inputs are retained separately in the reviewed Chrome DevTools MCP evidence.
The static tools are page-scoped progressive enhancement, not a durable government MCP service.
Source-derived content remains untrusted and the capture did not independently certify the cited official sources.
